feeds.title: Daily Stoic
feeds.description: You will get an introduction to Stoicism, a curated list of resources, Stoic exercises, a guide to help you through adversity, and much more!

feeds.title: Modern Stoicism
feeds.description: Modern Stoicism is a non-profit limited company, registered in the UK (10950027), run by a multidisciplinary team of volunteers. Its aims are to research and publish information on the application of Stoic philosophy to modern living for the benefit of the general public.

feeds.title: Donald Robertson Blog
feeds.description: Donald is a writer and trainer, with over twenty years' experience. He's a specialist in teaching evidence-based psychological skills, and known as an expert on the relationship between modern cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and classical Greek and Roman philosophy.

feeds.title: What Is Stoicism?
feeds.description: What Is Stoicism? is a combination of original content and the best-curated resources from around the web to help you benefit from adopting Stoicism as your philosophy of life.

feeds.title: Reflections on Theology and Moral Philosophy » Stoic Philosophers
feeds.description: This blog is about Catholic, Orthodox, Jewish and Christian Teachings and Doctrines / Greek, Stoic, and Moral Philosophy.

feeds.title: The Stoic Handbook
feeds.description: Jon Brooks is the co-owner of HighExistence. His aim is to take ancient, esoteric wisdom and translate it for modern people who seek self-fulfillment. Reading The Stoic Handbook is the ultimate way to digest ancient Stoic wisdom, with upgraded visual flowcharts and modern interpretations.

feeds.title: Stoic Simple Blog
feeds.description: Stoicism is simply a way of looking at the world that makes you happier. It's been changing people's lives for thousands of years, and it's super easy to learn. Our mission is simple: we want to share Stoic ideas in the clearest, easiest way possible. By keeping it simple, we hope that this website helps a few more people think Stoically and live happier life.

feeds.title: A Stoic Breviary Blog
feeds.description: Building upon many years of privately shared thoughts on the real benefits of Stoic Philosophy, Liam Milburn eventually published a selection of Stoic passages that had helped him to live well. They were accompanied by some of his own personal reflections. This blog hopes to continue his mission of encouraging the wisdom of Stoicism in the exercise of everyday life. All the reflections are taken from his notes, from late 1992 to early 2017.

feeds.title: Blog of the APA » Stoicism
feeds.description: The Official Blog of the American Philosophical Association. American Philosophical Association, the premier philosophical learned society in North America. A creator and editor of Ordinary Philosophy blog, podcast, and history of ideas travel series.

feeds.title: The Immoderate Stoic Blog
feeds.description: Immoderate Stoic provides resources, insights, and the podcast, Good Fortune, to promote the life philosophy of Stoicism.

feeds.title: Wise Up Blog
feeds.description: Karen Duffy has done it all - model, MTV VJ, actress, correspondent for the Emmy-winning TV Nation, host of HBO's 'The Buzz,' and more. None of it prepared her fully for motherhood. Raising her son Jack, she drew on reserves of wisdom she found in the strangest of places and the result is Wise Up. In Wise up, Karen Duffy shares funny and insightful lessons on life, motherhood, and dancing bears, drawn from her love of Stoic philosophy.

feeds.title: Stoic Insights
feeds.description: Ancient Stoic philosophy is experiencing a well-deserved modern revival because its timeless ethical and psychological teachings focus on the art of living - and how to flourish - in a world that feels out of control. This website, Stoic Insights, offers modern reflections on classic Stoic teachings, along with information on the best Stoic resources available today.

feeds.title: Mountain Stoic
feeds.description: Kevin was first exposed to Stoicism by a fortuitous twist of fate in a middle school Latin course, where he came to be known by the name of 'Epictetus' after finding a copy of The Golden Sayings on his family bookshelf. He has been writing about Stoic Philosophy at MountainStoic.com since 2014.

feeds.title: Stoic Stok Talk
feeds.description: Social-Emotional Learning through a Stoic lens - A blog from Assistant Principal Patrick Swett. I would like to use this platform to introduce the Stoklosa community to Stoicism, an ancient Hellenistic philosophy with practical applications in modern society. Stoic teachings can help us navigate social dilemmas and cope emotionally with life's curveballs.

feeds.title: The Mad Stoic Blog
feeds.description: There aren't many people around these days that openly call themselves 'Stoic'. Still, someone to talk to is far and few between. Call this an open journal. I talk, you read, you respond, I talk back, maybe. It's all about the feedback, friends.

feeds.title: Spiritual Stoicism
feeds.description: I generally seek to develop new writings and thought for a new Stoa in our modern times. I think there are four general categories of ideas that I'll be talking about: explaining concepts, new thoughts, rebuttals, and practices.

feeds.title: Practical Stoicism
feeds.description: Those approaching Stoicism for the first time, with the intention of adopting it as a life philosophy, can find it both impossibly dense and extreme in its expectations of its students. For this reason, it is important that there exists a practical interpretation of the high-minded values of this ancient philosophy. This podcast helps newcomers get acquainted and comfortable with the practical aspects of Stoicism.

feeds.title: The Stoic Within
feeds.description: The Stoic Within's mission is to spread the history and application of Stoic philosophy to better help individuals live their best lives.
